integrity: The lower bound is an all-odd-prime analytic argument using flat-support parametrization, an exact carry-function restriction, affine invariance of hierarchy level, and the stabilizer-state finite-difference classification. The included finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the tetrahedral triangulation of the sphere and to standard elementary nontrivial type-I or type-II cocycle representatives, including nonzero powers of a single elementary factor.
It does not establish the broader phase-level conjecture, arbitrary triangulations, arbitrary cocycle gauges, mixed elementary factors, or type-III-only twists.
title: Exact level-\(p\) stabilizer hierarchy for canonical elementary type-I and type-II TQD states on the tetrahedral sphere
